name: Four Eyes, Four Ears
body:
It is very difficult to blind or deafen you.

Prerequisite: Taddol

Benefit: You can roll twice for a saving throw versus a blindness or deafness effect and take the best result.

Remarkable Races: Compendium of Unusual PC Races, Pathway to Adventure Edition Copyright 2009, Alluria Publishing; Author: J. Matthew Kubisz
